text: I think you have a misunderstanding. The stage light has nothing to do with the light rigs at all
resolution: Correct — I had conflated the model-stage light (the viewer's ambient/key rig, req_2545) with the authored LightRig emitters, and my 'rig never reaches the mesh draw' claim was wrong on top of it: the byte-identical before/after shots came from a stale baseline (the 'before' binary already embedded the new key direction; headless renders are deterministic). Proved it with probe builds: a red ambient and a green key both visibly land on the mesh, and the restored rig's rendered faces fit the lighting arithmetic exactly (base 191, ambient 0.65, key 0.35 predicts 179/157/148; measured 180/156/148). The substantive finding survives: the stage key had been aimed at the model's underside since req_2545 (direction is toward-the-light in the shader), which is why every visible face sat at flat ambient and modelling read blind — the direction fix (commit amended to 767a2c3fe) is live and separates the principal axes. Memory and the board note corrected; cavity/AO or matcap remains the open P1-0 follow-up.
